title: Interface: HUD modules, cue key, on-screen copy and vehicle barks
gap: P1's HUD is a developer panel. It shows 'VIEW · Scanners in view cone', 'Drivers: Highway Code', 'Sensors: straight ahead'.
It does not use the six HUD modules the GDD names (D10.5: BODY, CHARGE, FLEET, CONTRACT, SHIFT, RECORD).
The cue grammar (state pip: chevron, closed ring, opening ring, red broken ring; caution triangle; spent slash) is explained nowhere in the game.
On-screen copy is placeholder English: 'Cars dodge you: get hit head-on for the big payoff.' It is not FARSIGHT's voice.
Vehicles never speak, although D9.3 says they speak as workers. There are no bilingual district identifiers (D9.2 anchor 2).
deliverable: HUD layout: the D10.5 modules split into a left and right column, each row bound to a sim fact the renderer can draw.
Module titles in English with a Chinese title marked for editorial review.
A cue key for the pause screen: one line per cue the field draws.
A copy deck: intro banner, denial lines, toasts, report, shop, endings, frame identifier.
A bark bank: short lines vehicles say, each bound to a logged sim event and only its fields.

subject.chassis.shows: chassis number of the current body

body.difficulty.shows: difficulty setting name and body health

body.health.shows: health bar with numbers; flashes red below 30%

contract.writeOffs.shows: write-off boxes for this road and the count

contract.road.shows: road n of 3 and its name

build.nodes.shows: Torso and Arms nodes, owned state

fleet.models.shows: each model ID and its current stop distance in metres; red once learned

fleet.note.shows: one-line note under the fleet list (label text only)

shift.next.shows: class and seconds until the next admission

schema: "left":  [ {"module": allowed.modules, "title": "EN title", "zh": "Chinese title", "review": "pending", "rows": [ {"fact": allowed.facts key, "label": "short label"} ], "sources": [...]} ],
Placeholders in copy use only the names listed in allowed.copy_placeholders for that key. Bark placeholders and 'when' keys use only that event's fields plus model and cls.
consumer: drawHUD() draws hud.left in the left column and hud.right in the right column, in order. Each module prints its title and Chinese title as an eyebrow, then its rows.
Each fact has a fixed widget and height (allowed.facts). A column must fit its budget: sum of rows + header and gap per module.
Labels print in 10-12 px type inside a 216-unit column. Keep them short.
cueKey prints on the pause screen beside the menu, each line next to the real glyph the field uses.
Copy strings replace the P1 literals with the same role. {placeholders} are filled by the renderer.
Barks show for proto.ui.barkSeconds as a tag beside the car named by the event. At most one bark per car, and none within proto.ui.barkCooldown of the last.

Sim event fields: impact {model, cls, zone, closing, angle, assessed, lost, carState, bait, lunging, stopped, learnedStandoff}; touch-spent {car}; honk {car, at: 'body' or a cone id}; commit {car, man: 'shift' or 'brake', cause}; interrupt {car, by}; unstick {car, how: 'reverse' or 'replan'}; admit {car, cls, model, lane}.

voices.FARSIGHT (all UI copy: banner, denials,: The corporate terminal. Polite, procedural, optimistic on the surface; dry register (D9.2, D10.1). It states facts the run logged.
voices.Vehicles (barks only): Workers: deadlines, rank, fear of retraining, resentment, pride. Corporate politeness barely contains personality (D9.3). A vehicle talks about its own job and the event just logged, never in FARSIGHT's slogans.

slots.intro[0]: Banner line 1 over the field for 4 s at the start of each road: which road, and how many write-offs clear it.
slots.intro[1]: Banner line 2: difficulty and body health, plus the one thing to do. Not a strategy hint.
slots.denied.lunge: Toast when A is refused: no charge, or still recovering. Refusals cost nothing.
slots.denied.pickup: Toast when B is pressed with Carry owned but no cone within reach.
slots.denied.drop: Toast when a held cone cannot be placed: no legal room ahead.
slots.denied.throw: Toast when a held cone cannot be thrown: no legal room ahead.
slots.toast.touch-spent: Toast when the dummy touches a car whose allowance is already spent: solid, no damage, no points.
slots.toast.drone-dispatch: Toast when a FARSIGHT drone flies in to move a cone that has blocked a car for 5 s.
slots.toast.purchase: Toast after a node is bought in the shop.
slots.toast.learn-standoff: Toast when a hit on a stopped car makes that model stop further back from now on. P1.8 decided this toast names the change.
slots.toast.refusal-locked: Toast when the visitor chooses 'Refuse testing' in the pause menu before completing one body.
slots.report.eyebrow: Small caps label above the write-off report.
slots.report.title: Headline of the report for a non-final write-off.
slots.report.line: Summary line: write-off n of the road's quota, and points this body.
slots.report.cleared: Summary line instead, when this write-off clears the road and the next road follows.
slots.report.credit: Line confirming one body credit was granted, with the new balance.
slots.report.continue: Prompt to press A to go on to the shop.
slots.shop.eyebrow: Small caps label above the shop.
slots.shop.title: Shop headline: modifications install on the next chassis.
slots.shop.deploy: Button when no credits remain: leave the shop and deploy the next chassis.
slots.shop.bank: Button when credits remain unspent: keep them for later and deploy the next chassis.
slots.shop.nodes.<node>: The node's action description under its name: what the visitor can now do (D3.9). Max two short sentences.
slots.endings.<kind>: Subtitle under the ending title (LICENSED, FAILED TEST, NON-COMPLIANT).
slots.frame.district: Header strip beside the FARSIGHT logo, always visible: district and test identifier.
slots.frame.districtZh: The same identifier in Chinese, shown after it.
